config.name: t110_growth_scaled_window
config._purpose: T110, T109's replacement on her words of 7 November 2026 (PREREGISTRATION.md): the outside foot's gain is positive over a window that scales with the length. T107's cell and runner, fresh seed; the recorded times after the escape are the T109 times scaled by L / 32 and rounded to the block, so the window is 200 to 500 sweeps at 32 and 800 to 2000 at 128. Fitting lengths 32 to 128; 256 held out in the _heldout config, run only after its number is written.
